title: Up to ₱490M in potential farm damage in Central Visayas amid El Niño

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Agricultural losses in Central Visayas could reach P490 million under a worst-case El Niño scenario. The Department of Agriculture (DA)-7 is preparing a P291-million emergency response fund and encouraging farmers to shift to drought-tolerant crops. Gerry Avila, chief of the DA-7 Field Operations Division, said the estimated losses came from assessments and coordination with local government units (LGUs) across the region as the agency prepares for prolonged dry conditions. The projection does not represent actual recorded damage, but the potential losses should the weather phenomenon intensify.
